Uday Agarwal
Senior Backend Engineer | Cochin
uday.agarwal103@example.com | +91 9577517536

Senior backend engineer focused on scalable services and high-throughput data pipelines. Strong track record building resilient microservices, reducing latency, and improving operational observability. Proven collaborator with product and SRE teams to deliver customer-impacting features.

Experience

Swiggy — Jun 2021 - Present
Senior Backend Engineer | Remote
- Designed and implemented an order routing service using Django and FastAPI, reducing median request latency by 32% and improving throughput to handle 18k requests/sec during peak windows; used Redis for caching hot keys.
- Built an event-driven pipeline with Apache Kafka for driver assignment and status events, increasing delivery of near-real-time events to downstream consumers by 4x and maintaining end-to-end SLAs under 500ms for 95% of messages.
- Containerized services with Docker and automated deployments to AWS; implemented Celery-based background workers for delayed task processing, cutting task failure rate by 45% through retry and idempotency improvements.
- Improved observability and incident resolution by standardizing logging and health checks on Linux hosts and integrating alerts into Jira workflows; reduced mean time to recovery by 28%.

HCLTech — Aug 2020 - May 2021
Python Developer | Onsite
- Developed microservices in FastAPI that processed streaming events from Apache Kafka, increasing processing capacity by 3x and lowering end-to-end processing time by 40%.
- Implemented Redis-based session and rate-limiting layers for public APIs, reducing backend load during traffic spikes and preventing service degradation for 99.5% of requests.
- Packaged services with Docker and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Git; collaborated with cross-functional teams via Jira to deliver three major releases on schedule.

Projects

Real-time Inventory Monitor
- Prototype service combining Kafka consumers with FastAPI endpoints and Redis caches to surface inventory anomalies to dashboards; detected stockouts 2x faster than previous polling approach.

Background Task Orchestrator
- Lightweight Celery-based job orchestrator deployed in Docker on AWS to manage periodic data hygiene jobs and metric rollups, improving batch completion rates and easing on-call burden.
